facts.label: Preços e pedidos
facts.sub: Use How much is…? para perguntar o preço. Use I’d like… para pedir com educação: I’d like to join the gym. Would you like…? é a oferta.

facts.label: Preços
facts.sub: Para perguntar o preço, use How much is…? How much is one month? How much is a locker? Para vários itens, use How much are…? Responda com It’s forty dollars.

facts.label: Pedir
facts.sub: Para pedir com educação, use I’d like + coisa ou I’d like to + verbo. I’d like the monthly plan. I’d like to join the gym. Would you like…? é a oferta.

pages.title: A gym · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday evening at a gym in Melbourne. People run on machines and lift weights. Marco stands near the front desk. He looks at a price list on the wall. Vera smiles from behind the desk. She says hello.
“Hello! Welcome to Fit Place. How can I help?” says Vera. “Hi. I’d like to join the gym.” says Marco. “Great! Would you like a month or a year?” says Vera.
